title: dispatch ends the processes a worker session leaves running in its worktree, so land does not stop at step branch
goal: After a headless worker exits, dispatch ends the processes whose working directory is in the worker's worktree and whose parent is gone (orphaned MCP servers the session started) through end_orphans(worktree), in bl_dispatch or bl_procs, which returns each pid and command it ended for dispatch to print and leaves a process whose parent lives, so backlog.py land does not stop at step branch on them

run:
import os,signal,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_dispatch,bl_procs
f=getattr(bl_dispatch,"end_orphans",None) or getattr(bl_procs,"end_orphans",None)
d=os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp())
o=int(s.run([sys.executable,"-c","import subprocess as s,sys;print(s.Popen([\"sleep\",\"60\"],cwd=sys.argv[1],start_new_session=True,stdin=s.DEVNULL,stdout=s.DEVNULL,stderr=s.DEVNULL).pid)",d],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
live=s.Popen(["sleep","61"],cwd=d);time.sleep(0.5)
alive=lambda x:s.run(["kill","-0",str(x)],capture_output=True).returncode==0
try:
    ended=f(d) if f else None;time.sleep(0.5)
    ok=not alive(o) and str(o) in str(ended) and live.poll() is None
    print("orphan",o,"ended:",not alive(o),"| named:",ended,"| live child kept:",live.poll() is None,"| end_orphans present:",f is not None)
finally:
    live.kill()
    if alive(o):os.kill(o,signal.SIGKILL)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
